name: briefing_action_set_objective_picture_image_timed_tick
description: HudUiBriefingAction_SetObjectivePictureImageTimed::Tick redraws the picture base, sets the borrowed image, rebuilds rects, shows and invalidates the widget, stores timer as noise alpha, and completes after the fixed timer decrement goes below zero.
known_limits: Focused VC5 COFF byte comparison is clean under briefing_text_block_order_current_shape; owner tier S remains deferred to the complete Briefing source-owner because 0x403930 remains byte-blocked.
The prior smoke described action-vtable/table-slot assertions and must be refreshed before this target is reused as current tier evidence.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x404960 validates target DrawBase, HudUiWidget::SetImageBorrowedAndInvalidate, RebuildBltRectFromImage, SetVisible(1), storing timer to HudUiBriefingObjectivePicture::noiseAlpha, Invalidate, timer -= 0.5, return 0 while timer >= 0.0 and return 1 when timer < 0.0. Slot offsets are ABI evidence only.

The native smoke validates image assignment, ownsImage clear, noise alpha sequence ending at 0.0, timer -0.5, three draw/rebuild/show effects, six invalidates, and return values 0, 0, 1; action-table invocation assertions are stale after the source-model cleanup.
